adjustments.title: Manual adjustments
adjustments.description: Only the organizers see this list.
adjustments.label: Manual rating adjustments
adjustments.hint: Doesn't count as a game. It's recorded with the reason and your name.
adjustments.reasonHint: For example, a rating from another league or a penalty.

settings.title: Community rating
settings.kMaxHint: The K-factor is how much a game moves the rating. It starts at this value and drops exponentially to the minimum as the rating becomes more accurate. Between players with the same rating, a win is worth half of the K-factor.
settings.kMinHint: If it's the same as the starting K-factor, the K-factor doesn't drop.
settings.kDecayHint: After this many games, the K-factor has dropped about 63% of the way to the minimum.

recompute.title: Save and recalculate
recompute.text: The entire history will be recalculated with these values, and everyone's rating changes.
